newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lindsay started with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lindsay started with buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said it began coverage of Lindsay Manufacturing Co with a buy rating.
-- It set a 12-month fair value target price of $50 a share. Lindsay shares on Monday afternoon were up 1-1/2 at 42-1/4.

-- Dain estimates earnings for Lindsay, which makes irrigation systems and parts for off-highway equipment, at $3.00 a share for fiscal 1997 and $3.45 for fiscal 1998. It added these estimates are higher than current consensus, but "quite achievable."

-- "The company is taking advantage of strong agriculture equipment markets, gathering additional business in the more profitable manufacturing area and generating plenty of cash," Dain said in a report. A share repurchase program and recently initiated stock dividend are the most prominent uses of this wealth."
